name: CHSA Placement Childcare Subsidy (Coffs Harbour)
summary: Up to $200 per placement towards out-of-pocket childcare costs for CHSA members living in the Coffs Harbour region.
key: You can claim up to $200 per placement, per student!
who: Current CHSA members who live in the Coffs Harbour Greater Region.
how: Send your placement certificate, childcare statement and proof of address to CHSA.
catches: CHSA membership costs $5 to join, then $1 to renew.

evidence.quote: You can claim up to $200 per placement, per student!
Available to current CHSA Members who reside in the Coffs Harbour Greater Region.
